Hi Chloe —

Thanks for the summary and the clear next steps. Quick answers below: 

- Form choice: SIG-lite is preferred by Security for initial onboarding. Procurement may still request CAIQ later, but SIG-lite will get us through the first approval gate.
- SOC 2: we maintain SOC 2 Type II; our latest report is for period ending 2026-11-30.
- HIPAA: we are not a HIPAA covered entity; we do handle PCI and payment data controls.
- GDPR: we operate globally but for this integration all PII in scope is US-resident for the initial rollout.
- Data residency: production payment vaults and transaction logs must stay in US regions; non-prod/test/staging can be multi-region.

I attached the procurement guidance doc in my system (will share if needed) — for now SIG-lite works. Please include any evidence mapping to SOC 2 controls, and call out where Redwood would host keys/backups.

Cc'ing Dana (security ops) to confirm there aren't additional proof points they'd want with the SIG-lite.
